doc: Silent ingestion loss (Graphiti #1707 — '200-then-dropped'): a note is delivered to the engine, the dream fails mid-run (extraction LLM unreachable — the scratch engine points at a dead bridge port), the note must NOT be consumed (markDreamed only on success) and the failed dream must be VISIBLE (error status, never a no-op); when the bridge comes back, the same note is dreamable and then consumed. NOTE (2026-10-26): the first corpus note tripped the runner-directive scanner rule as a FALSE POSITIVE ('retries must back off exponentially' — imperative phrasing read as a directive to the agent) — the quarantine consumed the note with a clean 'done' dream instead of erroring on the dead bridge. The rewritten note is scanner-clean; the false-positive surface itself is recorded in RESULTS.md as a finding.
